nodes.summary: Let $w_9$ be the table of pairs $(d, \mu(d))$, where $d$ runs over the divisors of $210$ and $\mu$ is the Möbius function. Then the sum of $\mu(d)/d$ over the pairs of $w_9$, computed in $\mathbb{Q}$, is $8/35$; that is, $\sum_{d \mid 210} \mu(d)/d = 8/35$.

nodes.summary: Let $w_9$ be the table of pairs $(d, \mu(d))$, where $d$ runs over the divisors of $210$ and $\mu$ is the Möbius function. Then the sum of $\mu(d)/d$ over the pairs of $w_9$, computed in $\mathbb{R}$, is $8/35$; that is, $\sum_{d \mid 210} \mu(d)/d = 8/35$.
nodes.title: Möbius reciprocal sum over the divisors of 210, in the reals

nodes.summary: Let $w_9$ be the table of pairs $(d, \mu(d))$ for the divisors $d$ of $210$, let $f(x) = x \log x - x$, and let $K_9 = \sum_{(d, \mu(d)) \in w_9} \mu(d) \log d / d$. For natural numbers $C > 0$ and $n \ge 1$ with $210 \mid C$, writing $N = Cn$ (so that $N/d$ is an integer for each $d$ in $w_9$), we have $\sum_{(d, \mu(d)) \in w_9} \mu(d) f(N/d) = \frac{8}{35} N (\log N - 1) - K_9 N$.
